overlap_check: No existing methodology on learning models. New.

payload.name: Learning Models Train Continuously
payload.description: The ranking and keyword models are pipelines that train every cycle on any usable labelled group. Promotion only decides which versioned copy serves, judged by a yes or no held-out evaluation.

principles.name: Training is continuous
principles.description: Waiting for a promotion or a data threshold throws away learning.

heuristics.condition: a held-out split cannot be made because too few groups exist
heuristics.action: keep training and report that evaluation is pending; do not stop

heuristics.condition: training is proposed to wait for something
heuristics.action: ask what it protects and use the versioned serving copy for that

decision_rules.name: Train every cycle
decision_rules.condition: a labelled group exists, however small
decision_rules.outcome: warm-start the rolling candidate and train it; keep the requirements for training low

decision_rules.name: Promotion decides serving only
decision_rules.outcome: promote it by a yes or no held-out evaluation, serve a versioned copy, and never let the promotion step gate training

decision_rules.name: Models are pipelines
decision_rules.condition: a new model, encoder or ranker is added
decision_rules.outcome: place it as a pipeline that can be swapped or used alongside others as they come online

decision_rules.name: Keep long jobs in their own actor
decision_rules.condition: a long training or settlement job runs
decision_rules.outcome: run it in its own actor, not inside a pass that gates other work, so the meta loop is not starved
